issues.where: the whole sphere, also crops 1-6 in set-B-02.jpg
issues.what: the frost covers the entire globe as a uniform white scribble of constant line weight and opacity, reading as scratched or crazed plastic; it veils the miniature evenly instead of gathering where frost would and the behind-glass scene reads through a flat decal
issues.fix: confine the frost to the rim and lower third, let it thin, break up, and vary in line weight and transparency, and keep the centre of the glass clear so the scene reads

issues.where: crop 5, the pond and the ground around it
issues.what: the lower interior is blown out to a flat cream haze; the pond, grass and lamp light lose all modelling, so the miniature reads as a low-detail wash
issues.fix: exposure down on the lower interior, restore the water reflection and grass texture, and keep the lamp glow localised to its source

issues.where: crops 1, 2 and 4, repeated also in set-C-02.jpg crop 2
issues.what: the dandelion snowflakes reuse one identical starburst stamp; many heads match spoke for spoke at different scales, which reads as a brush preset rather than individual seeds
issues.fix: vary the spoke count, length and fill per seed, rotate a few off-axis, and break some into partial drifts

issues.where: the right of the glass, also set-C-03.jpg crop 9
issues.what: broad white smears on the glass have a fibrous, brushed edge, reading as smudged paint strokes rather than a smooth reflection bent around the sphere
issues.fix: replace with soft elongated reflections that follow the sphere's curvature with clean feathered edges

issues.where: crop 12, the sand spill right of the base, repeated in set-B-03.jpg crop 12
issues.what: the gold glitter hangs in a band above the sand at one depth and one focus, nearly all one size, with none settled on the sand or table
issues.fix: settle most grains on the surfaces, and spread the airborne few across depth of field with varied size

issues.what: the water is mirror-flat with generic soft vertical streaks that don't line up with the lanterns above; at native size it reads as a gradient sheet, not water
issues.fix: add fine ripple texture and tie each reflection to the lamp and tree shapes directly above it
